doc: ratatoskr job propose: a plan file from the command line becomes a proposed job (text: its tasks, a hint to approve it; --json: the hub's answer on one line); the plan path, --repo and --budget reach job/propose; a budget that is not a number, a missing plan and an unknown option are usage errors (exit 2) that call nothing; a plan the hub refuses is exit 1 with its text on stderr.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init

expect_stdout: Task 2: Check the note  — review on
Approve with: drgnx job approve job-
